تذدكرن (form VIII)
# تَذْدَكِرْنَ (taḏdakirna) /tað.da.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# تُذْدَكَرْنَ (tuḏdakarna) /tuð.da.kar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
